name: Shivani Ranchod
title: Co-founder
bio: Shivani Ranchod is a serial entrepreneur: a creative way of moving through the world that has been made possible by surrendering to working collectively. Her work is interstitial: connecting insights, people and resources across sectors, disciplines and siloed positionalities. Drawing on experience as an actuary, academic, Buddhist and breathworker, she has come to see that durable insight rarely lives in a single expert: it accumulates collectively, in the traces people leave each other when someone tends the structure with care. In her current role at Alignd, she is part of a team that is birthing a new maternity programme into the world.
